title: Rayu hub (aimbot) BETA
script:
local P=game:GetService("Players")
local R=game:GetService("RunService")
local U=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local W=game:GetService("Workspace")
local LP=P.LocalPlayer
local Cam=W.CurrentCamera

local S={AimbotOn=false,ESPOn=false,TeamCheck=false,VisibleOnly=false,FOV=120,Mode="AIM"}
local ET={}
local HT={}
local isWide=true
local isMin=false
local uiVis=true

local C={
BG=Color3.fromRGB(18,18,26),SC=Color3.fromRGB(28,28,40),SA=Color3.fromRGB(36,36,50),
AO=Color3.fromRGB(52,52,68),TX=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,245),ST=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,170),
OK=Color3.fromRGB(46,204,113),SK=Color3.fromRGB(60,60,80),LC=Color3.fromRGB(231,76,60)
}

local function co(p,r)
    local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 6);c.Parent=p;return c
end
local function str(p,c,t,tr)
    local s=Instance.new("UIStroke");s.Color=c or C.SK;s.Thickness=t or 1;s.Transparency=tr or 0;s.Parent=p;return s
end
local function pd(p,t,b,l,r)
    local u=Instance.new("UIPadding");u.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,t);u.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,b)
    u.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,l);u.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,r);u.Parent=p;return u
end

local SG=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SG.Name="RayuHub";SG.ResetOnSpawn=false;SG.IgnoreGuiInset=true
SG.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling;SG.Parent=LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local FOV=Instance.new("Frame")
FOV.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5);FOV.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
FOV.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(S.FOV*2,S.FOV*2);FOV.BackgroundTransparency=1
FOV.Visible=false;FOV.ZIndex=1;FOV.Parent=SG
co(FOV,9999);str(FOV,Color3.new(1,1,1),1.5,0.15)

local function upFov() FOV.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(S.FOV*2,S.FOV*2) end

-- TOGGLE MENU
local TB=Instance.new("TextButton")
TB.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,32);TB.Position=UDim2.new(0,16,0,16)
TB.BackgroundColor3=C.BG;TB.BorderSizePixel=0;TB.Text="R";TB.TextColor3=C.OK
TB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;TB.TextSize=15;TB.AutoButtonColor=false
TB.ZIndex=10;TB.Parent=SG;co(TB,16);str(TB,C.OK,1.5,0.3)

local HH=28
local TH=26
local FH=16
local WW=280
local WH=200
local TW=200
local TLH=320

local M=Instance.new("Frame")
M.Position=UDim2.new(0,40,0,260);M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(WW,WH)
M.BackgroundColor3=C.BG;M.BorderSizePixel=0;M.ZIndex=5;M.Parent=SG
co(M,8);str(M,C.SK,1,0.25)

TB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() uiVis=not uiVis;M.Visible=uiVis end)

local Tit=Instance.new("Frame")
Tit.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,HH);Tit.BackgroundColor3=C.SC;Tit.BorderSizePixel=0
Tit.ZIndex=6;Tit.Parent=M;co(Tit,8)

local TL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
TL.Size=UDim2.new(1,-80,1,0);TL.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0)
TL.BackgroundTransparency=1;TL.Text="Rayu Hub";TL.TextColor3=C.TX
TL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;TL.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
TL.TextSize=12;TL.ZIndex=7;TL.Parent=Tit

local LB=Instance.new("TextButton")
LB.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16);LB.Position=UDim2.new(1,-58,0.5,-8)
LB.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;LB.BorderSizePixel=0;LB.Text="&";LB.TextColor3=C.TX
LB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;LB.TextSize=11;LB.AutoButtonColor=false;LB.ZIndex=7;LB.Parent=Tit;co(LB,3)

local MinB=Instance.new("TextButton")
MinB.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16);MinB.Position=UDim2.new(1,-40,0.5,-8)
MinB.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;MinB.BorderSizePixel=0;MinB.Text="—";MinB.TextColor3=C.TX
MinB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;MinB.TextSize=12;MinB.AutoButtonColor=false;MinB.ZIndex=7;MinB.Parent=Tit;co(MinB,3)

local ClB=Instance.new("TextButton")
ClB.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16);ClB.Position=UDim2.new(1,-22,0.5,-8)
ClB.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;ClB.BorderSizePixel=0;ClB.Text="×";ClB.TextColor3=C.TX
ClB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;ClB.TextSize=13;ClB.AutoButtonColor=false;ClB.ZIndex=7;ClB.Parent=Tit;co(ClB,3)

ClB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _,v in pairs(ET) do if v then v:Destroy() end end
    for _,d in pairs(HT) do
        if d.hl then d.hl:Destroy() end
        if d.lt then d.lt:Destroy() end
    end
    SG:Destroy()
end)

local TabB=Instance.new("Frame")
TabB.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,HH);TabB.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,TH)
TabB.BackgroundColor3=C.SC;TabB.BorderSizePixel=0;TabB.ZIndex=6;TabB.Parent=M

local tabPD=Instance.new("UIPadding")
tabPD.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,4);tabPD.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,4)
tabPD.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8);tabPD.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8);tabPD.Parent=TabB

local tabL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
tabL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;tabL.Padding=UDim.new(0,5)
tabL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;tabL.Parent=TabB

local function mkTab(t,o)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0);b.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;b.BorderSizePixel=0
    b.Text=t;b.TextColor3=C.ST;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextSize=10
    b.AutoButtonColor=false;b.LayoutOrder=o;b.ZIndex=7;b.Parent=TabB;co(b,5);return b
end

local TabA=mkTab("🎯 Aimbot",1)
local TabC=mkTab("⚙️ Config",2)

local function setTab(a,b)
    a.BackgroundColor3=C.OK;a.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;b.TextColor3=C.ST
end

local Cont=Instance.new("Frame")
Cont.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,HH+TH);Cont.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-(HH+TH+FH))
Cont.BackgroundTransparency=1;Cont.Parent=M;pd(Cont,8,8,8,8)

local AC=Instance.new("Frame")
AC.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);AC.BackgroundTransparency=1;AC.Parent=Cont

local ACL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ACL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;ACL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6)
ACL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;ACL.Parent=AC

local AL=Instance.new("Frame")
AL.LayoutOrder=1;AL.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0);AL.BackgroundTransparency=1;AL.Parent=AC
local ALL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ALL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);ALL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;ALL.Parent=AL

local AR=Instance.new("Frame")
AR.LayoutOrder=2;AR.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0);AR.BackgroundTransparency=1;AR.Parent=AC
local ARL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ARL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);ARL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;ARL.Parent=AR

local CC=Instance.new("Frame")
CC.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);CC.BackgroundTransparency=1;CC.Visible=false;CC.Parent=Cont

local CCL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
CCL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;CCL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6)
CCL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;CCL.Parent=CC

local CL=Instance.new("Frame")
CL.LayoutOrder=1;CL.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0);CL.BackgroundTransparency=1;CL.Parent=CC
local CLL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
CLL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);CLL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;CLL.Parent=CL

local CR=Instance.new("Frame")
CR.LayoutOrder=2;CR.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0);CR.BackgroundTransparency=1;CR.Parent=CC
local CRL=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
CRL.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);CRL.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;CRL.Parent=CR

TabA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AC.Visible=true;CC.Visible=false;setTab(TabA,TabC)
end)
TabC.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AC.Visible=false;CC.Visible=true;setTab(TabC,TabA)
end)
setTab(TabA,TabC)

local Ft=Instance.new("Frame")
Ft.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-FH);Ft.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,FH)
Ft.BackgroundTransparency=1;Ft.ZIndex=7;Ft.Parent=M

local FtL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
FtL.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);FtL.BackgroundTransparency=1
FtL.Text="By rayu_894";FtL.TextColor3=C.ST;FtL.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
FtL.TextSize=9;FtL.ZIndex=7;FtL.Parent=Ft

local function wide()
    isWide=true
    ACL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    AL.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;AL.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0)
    AR.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;AR.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0)
    CCL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    CL.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;CL.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0)
    CR.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;CR.Size=UDim2.new(0.5,-3,1,0)
    if not isMin then M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(WW,WH) end
end

local function tall()
    isWide=false
    ACL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    AL.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0);AL.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    AR.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0);AR.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    CCL.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    CL.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0);CL.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    CR.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0);CR.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    if not isMin then M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(TW,TLH) end
end

LB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if isWide then tall() else wide() end end)

MinB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMin=not isMin
    if isMin then
        AC.Visible=false;CC.Visible=false;TabB.Visible=false
        M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(isWide and WW or TW,HH)
    else
        TabB.Visible=true
        if TabA.BackgroundColor3==C.OK then AC.Visible=true else CC.Visible=true end
        if isWide then M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(WW,WH) else M.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(TW,TLH) end
    end
end)

local function sec(parent,title,order)
    local s=Instance.new("Frame")
    s.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0);s.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    s.BackgroundColor3=C.SC;s.BorderSizePixel=0;s.LayoutOrder=order;s.Parent=parent
    co(s,6);pd(s,6,6,6,6)
    local l=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    l.Padding=UDim.new(0,5);l.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;l.Parent=s
    local t=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,12);t.BackgroundTransparency=1;t.Text=title
    t.TextColor3=C.ST;t.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;t.TextSize=9;t.LayoutOrder=0;t.Parent=s
    return s
end

local function tog(parent,text,order)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24);b.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;b.BorderSizePixel=0
    b.Text="";b.AutoButtonColor=false;b.LayoutOrder=order;b.Parent=parent;co(b,5)
    local l=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size=UDim2.new(1,-45,1,0);l.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0);l.BackgroundTransparency=1
    l.Text=text;l.TextColor3=C.TX;l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;l.TextSize=10;l.Parent=b
    local st=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    st.Size=UDim2.new(0,30,1,0);st.Position=UDim2.new(1,-38,0,0);st.BackgroundTransparency=1
    st.Text="OFF";st.TextColor3=C.ST;st.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    st.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;st.TextSize=9;st.Parent=b
    local function r(on)
        if on then
            b.BackgroundColor3=C.OK;st.Text="ON";st.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        else
            b.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;st.Text="OFF";st.TextColor3=C.ST
        end
    end
    return b,r,l
end

local function txt(parent,init,order)
    local b=Instance.new("TextBox")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24);b.BackgroundColor3=C.SA;b.BorderSizePixel=0
    b.Text=tostring(init);b.PlaceholderText="120";b.TextColor3=C.TX
    b.PlaceholderColor3=C.ST;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;b.TextSize=10
    b.ClearTextOnFocus=false;b.LayoutOrder=order;b.Parent=parent;co(b,5);str(b,C.SK,1,0.4)
    return b
end

local function vis(p)
    local cp=Cam.CFrame.Position
    local d=(p.Position-cp).Unit
    local di=(p.Position-cp).Magnitude
    local rp=RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={LP.Character,Cam}
    rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.IgnoreWater=true
    local r=W:Raycast(cp,d*di,rp)
    return not r or r.Instance:IsDescendantOf(p.Parent)
end

local function mkHL(pl)
    if HT[pl.UserId] then
        local d=HT[pl.UserId]
        if d.hl and d.hl.Parent~=pl.Character then d.hl.Parent=pl.Character end
        if d.lt and d.lt.Parent~=pl.Character then d.lt.Parent=pl.Character end
        return
    end
    local red=Color3.fromRGB(255,40,40)

    local h=Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Name="RayuHL"
    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    h.FillColor=red
    h.OutlineColor=red
    h.FillTransparency=0.55
    h.OutlineTransparency=0
    h.Adornee=pl.Character
    h.Parent=pl.Character

    local root=pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pl.Character
    local lt=Instance.new("PointLight")
    lt.Name="RayuLight"
    lt.Color=red
    lt.Brightness=3
    lt.Range=14
    lt.Shadows=true
    lt.Parent=root

    HT[pl.UserId]={hl=h, lt=lt}
end

local function rmHL(pl)
    if HT[pl.UserId] then
        if HT[pl.UserId].hl then HT[pl.UserId].hl:Destroy() end
        if HT[pl.UserId].lt then HT[pl.UserId].lt:Destroy() end
        HT[pl.UserId]=nil
    end
end

local modeS=sec(AL,"MODO",1)
local modeB=Instance.new("TextButton")
modeB.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24);modeB.BackgroundColor3=C.OK;modeB.BorderSizePixel=0
modeB.Text="";modeB.AutoButtonColor=false;modeB.LayoutOrder=1;modeB.Parent=modeS;co(modeB,5)

local modeL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
modeL.Size=UDim2.new(1,-45,1,0);modeL.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,0);modeL.BackgroundTransparency=1
modeL.Text="Mode: AIM";modeL.TextColor3=C.TX;modeL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
modeL.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;modeL.TextSize=10;modeL.Parent=modeB

local modeSt=Instance.new("TextLabel")
modeSt.Size=UDim2.new(0,30,1,0);modeSt.Position=UDim2.new(1,-38,0,0);modeSt.BackgroundTransparency=1
modeSt.Text="AIM";modeSt.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);modeSt.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
modeSt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;modeSt.TextSize=9;modeSt.Parent=modeB

local aS=sec(AL,"AIMBOT",2)
local aB,aR,aL=tog(aS,"Aimbot",1)
aB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    S.AimbotOn=not S.AimbotOn
    FOV.Visible=S.AimbotOn
    aR(S.AimbotOn)
end)

modeB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if S.Mode=="AIM" then
        S.Mode="LOCK"
        modeL.Text="Mode: LOCK";modeSt.Text="LOCK";modeB.BackgroundColor3=C.LC
        aL.Text="Aimlock"
        local sl=aS:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
        if sl then sl.Text="AIMLOCK" end
    else
        S.Mode="AIM"
        modeL.Text="Mode: AIM";modeSt.Text="AIM";modeB.BackgroundColor3=C.OK
        aL.Text="Aimbot"
        local sl=aS:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
        if sl then sl.Text="AIMBOT" end
    end
end)

local vB,vR=tog(aS,"Visible Only",2)
vB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    S.VisibleOnly=not S.VisibleOnly
    vR(S.VisibleOnly)
end)

local eS=sec(AR,"PLAYER ESP",1)
local eB,eR=tog(eS,"ESP Players",1)
eB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    S.ESPOn=not S.ESPOn
    eR(S.ESPOn)
    if not S.ESPOn then
        for _,v in pairs(ET) do if v then v:Destroy() end end
        ET={}
        for _,d in pairs(HT) do
            if d.hl then d.hl:Destroy() end
            if d.lt then d.lt:Destroy() end
        end
        HT={}
    end
end)

local fS=sec(CL,"FOV RANGE",1)
local fB=txt(fS,S.FOV,1)
fB.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local n=tonumber(fB.Text)
    if n and n>=10 and n<=1000 then
        S.FOV=math.floor(n);fB.Text=tostring(S.FOV);upFov()
    else
        fB.Text=tostring(S.FOV)
    end
end)

local tS=sec(CL,"TEAM CHECK",2)
local tB,tR=tog(tS,"Check Team",1)
tB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    S.TeamCheck=not S.TeamCheck
    tR(S.TeamCheck)
end)

local iS=sec(CR,"INFO",1)
local iL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
iL.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32);iL.BackgroundTransparency=1
iL.Text="Rayu Hub v2V\nBy rayu_894";iL.TextColor3=C.ST
iL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;iL.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
iL.TextSize=9;iL.TextWrapped=true;iL.LayoutOrder=1;iL.Parent=iS

local rS=sec(CR,"RESET",2)
local rB=Instance.new("TextButton")
rB.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24);rB.BackgroundColor3=C.AO;rB.BorderSizePixel=0
rB.Text="Reset FOV";rB.TextColor3=C.TX;rB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
rB.TextSize=10;rB.AutoButtonColor=false;rB.LayoutOrder=1;rB.Parent=rS;co(rB,5)
rB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    S.FOV=120;fB.Text="120";upFov()
end)

local dg,ds,sp
Tit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dg=true;ds=i.Position;sp=M.Position
    end
end)
Tit.InputEnded:Connect(function() dg=false end)
U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if not dg then return end
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local d=i.Position-ds
        M.Position=UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale,sp.X.Offset+d.X,sp.Y.Scale,sp.Y.Offset+d.Y)
    end
end)

local function tHead(p)
    if p==LP then return nil end
    local ch=p.Character
    if not ch then return nil end
    local h=ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not h or h.Health<=0 then return nil end
    local hd=ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not hd then return nil end
    if S.TeamCheck and p.Team~=nil and p.Team==LP.Team then return nil end
    if S.VisibleOnly and not vis(hd) then return nil end
    return hd
end

local function fT()
    local v=Cam.ViewportSize
    local c=Vector2.new(v.X/2,v.Y/2)
    local cl,cd=nil,S.FOV
    for _,p in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        local h=tHead(p)
        if h then
            local sc,on=Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(h.Position)
            if on and sc.Z>0 then
                local d=(Vector2.new(sc.X,sc.Y)-c).Magnitude
                if d<=cd then cl=h;cd=d end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if S.AimbotOn then
        local t=fT()
        if t then
            Cam.CFrame=CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position,t.Position)
        end
    end
    if not S.ESPOn then
        for uid,d in pairs(HT) do
            if d.hl then d.hl:Destroy() end
            if d.lt then d.lt:Destroy() end
        end
        HT={}
        return
    end
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Character then
            local ro=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hu=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if ro and hu and hu.Health>0 then
                if S.TeamCheck and p.Team~=nil and p.Team==LP.Team then
                    if ET[p.UserId] then ET[p.UserId]:Destroy();ET[p.UserId]=nil end
                    rmHL(p)
                else
                    mkHL(p)
                    if not ET[p.UserId] then
                        local bl=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bl.AlwaysOnTop=true
                        bl.Size=UDim2.new(0,180,0,36)
                        bl.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                        bl.Adornee=ro
                        bl.Parent=SG
                        local tx=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        tx.BackgroundTransparency=1
                        tx.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                        tx.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        tx.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,85,85)
                        tx.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                        tx.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                        tx.TextSize=11
                        tx.TextWrapped=true
                        tx.Parent=bl
                        ET[p.UserId]=bl
                    end
                    local bl=ET[p.UserId]
                    if bl and bl.Parent then
                        local inf=bl:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                        if inf then
                            local lr=LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local di=lr and math.floor((ro.Position-lr.Position).Magnitude) or 0
                            inf.Text="👤 "..p.Name.."\n💖 "..math.floor(hu.Health).." HP  |  📍 "..di.."m"
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                if ET[p.UserId] then ET[p.UserId]:Destroy();ET[p.UserId]=nil end
                rmHL(p)
            end
        end
    end
